differences: C012 used identical float32 encoder histories. C013 separately checks encoder and predictor real-input forwards/gradients, complete independently encoded paths, rollout and assigned goal costs. Only O0n3seed0 selected checkpoint is covered. Original repository computational files and all checkpoints remain unchanged; ignored helpers supply an explicit temporary inference wrapper. No test split, training or optimizer update.
contrary_evidence: Neither precision policy is guaranteed to pass; finite real-input coverage is not proof for all inputs. Full float64 may be slower and changes encoding from the float32 training cache. Agreement is not physical accuracy, masking benefit or generalization. Decoder gradients check original RGB reconstruction, not deployed task-loss gradients.
